briefing.geography: Four stepped growing terraces rise north of one clean water band.
goals: Run boilers on the three terraces and watch the pressure ledger.
Survive through wave 12 between the three boiler beds.
rules: The coal seams cluster on the highest terrace above the boiler beds.
The single water band has a broad north bank for legal sluice work.
Steam Wreckers attack from both growing terraces while Coal Thieves descend from the seam bed.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.
Feeds coal into the Steamworks pressure line.

briefing.geography: Four stepped growing terraces rise north of one clean water band.
goals: Run boilers on the three terraces and watch the pressure ledger.
Survive through wave 12 between the three boiler beds.
rules: The coal seams cluster on the highest terrace above the boiler beds.
The single water band has a broad north bank for legal sluice work.
Steam Wreckers attack from both growing terraces while Coal Thieves descend from the seam bed.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.
Feeds coal into the Steamworks pressure line.
